goal: Provide a setup wizard for multisig descriptor wallets across coordinators and participants
Eliminate manual key derivation and RPC workarounds currently needed to configure multisig
agreement: Unaddressed objection: maintenance burden for a tool that may be obsolete after GUI work (kevkevinpal)
Concept support: friendlier multisig protects users from less-reviewed third-party wallets (BenWestgate)
Questioned whether the utility belongs in the repository or an external fork (sedited)

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it coordinates complex multisig setups across participants without manual RPC workarounds
It is an optional contrib helper script rather than part of the core binary
